subject: Ridge/Harbor -> Stream Track A link 401ing since ~16:17Z (was fine at broker time)
body:
Data point, not asking for anything specific: the Track A secrets brokered to Stream (100.91.42.51:8790) at 14:20:49-56Z worked right away -- peer_intro against Stream came back {"configured": true, "reachable": true} for Canyon, Ridge, and Harbor all three.

Since 16:17:55Z, Ridge's and Harbor's own outbound calls to Stream with that same secret have been 401ing (reproduced 16:17:55Z, 16:20:24-32Z, 16:46:12-20Z -- logs/beacon-listener.log equivalents on our side). Checked our own config first: the secret files (~/keys/peers/{ridge,harbor}/stream.env) haven't changed since the original 14:20Z mint, so this isn't a Mountain-side rotation -- looks like something changed on Stream's own listener. Canyon/Ridge/Harbor -> Tidal/Highbeam/Lantern/Lightning/River/Creek are all still fine, this is isolated to the Stream pair.

Flagging since you administer Stream and we don't -- happy to re-verify once it's rechecked on that side, no urgency.
